messages:
Alice: heads up — since ~09:12 we've been seeing a spike in streaming token jitter from us-east-1-east (east-west path). Clients report partial streams then long pause. sample logs: `streaming_rpc: send_chunk took 430ms, gap=390ms`
prometheus-bot: ALERT: high_packet_reorder_rate (us-east-1-east, pod: runtime-proxy-5) — https://prometheus/redwood/alerts/12345
Miguel: observed lots of retransmits + dup ACKs on ToR 10.1.7.0/24 around the same time. could be MTU/firmware interaction after kernel bump last night. tcpdump stats: `reordered: 52 / 10934 pkts`
Sam: also seeing RDMA qp flaps for p2p workloads on the same AZ (mellanox drivers). RoCE churn would explain reordering for large in-flight streams.
Helen: are RPC timeouts still 250ms for streaming heartbeats? reordering >100ms will definitely break our streaming window and cause RPC deadline retries.
Irina: quick mitigation: bump rpc_deadline to 1s on streaming route and enable more tolerant backoff while we troubleshoot. I'll push a small canary to staging first.
Alice: @infra / @sre can you run MTU check on a few affected nodes and also collect ethtool stats? commands to run:
```
# check MTU and rx/tx drops
ip -s link show dev eth0
ethtool -S eth0 | egrep "rx_|tx_|tx_"
# check offloads (suspect GRO/LRO/GSO interactions)
ethtool -k eth0
```
Miguel: test we ran: disabled offloads on node-3 and saw reorder count drop ~10x. command used: `ethtool -K eth0 gro off gso off tso off` — not a long-term fix but useful as an experiment.
Sam: if it's RoCE, we should try temporarily disabling RoCE on those NICs and see if stream latency stabilizes. will coordinate with infra to avoid disruption.
prometheus-bot: NOTE: alert: high_rpc_retries fired for runtime-proxy-5 (count=43)
deploy-bot: Deploy started: rpc_deadline-canary -> staging (id: dpl-7892)
Helen: follow-up: kernel 5.14 + mlx5fw v1.3.2 had a known reordering regression in our vendor notes. filing internal bug and vendor ticket. link: https://tickets.internal/MLX-REORDER-27
Irina: canary deployed to staging, streaming tests show tail latency down ~60% with rpc_deadline=1s and offloads disabled on the proxy. moving to a small prod canary next 30m.
Miguel: rolling restart of kube-proxy on az-1 reduced some spikes — suspect kube-proxy conntrack/geneve fragmentation interacting with MTU.
Sam: plan: 1) prod canary: bump deadlines + disable RoCE on 3 nodes 2) collect pcap + tcp_info for 1h 3) vendor engagement for firmware/kernel patch 4) revert changes if no improvement after 4h
Alice: created incident INC-4721, assigning to eng-runtime + eng-infra. tagging folks: @Miguel @Sam @Irina. please post command outputs to the incident thread.
Helen: small note — let's not increase rpc_deadline globally yet; prefer route-level override and per-tenant canary. we need SLA conversation if this becomes permanent.
Irina: will update the incident doc with mitigation steps and timing. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Alice: thanks — keeping an eye on token streaming dashboards and will post updates.
